svg.title: Ooga Pier Phase 0 coordinate map
svg.desc: Two equal-scale top-down maps compare the existing pier with eleven proposed landmark reservations. A smaller coastal context map shows trails, roads, entrance, Muscle Beach and the offshore lighthouse. All locations are authored local coordinates in metres, not geographic compass bearings or surveyed GPS locations.

g.text: Source coordinates in metres. +Z inland; −Z toward open ocean. X follows the coast.
Orange dashed shapes are proposals. Ride envelopes include planning clearance; runtime access is not yet verified.
1: carousel move + raised aquarium floor are conditional.
Each panel keeps equal X/Z scale.
Bridge and two ramps continue beyond this crop.
Planning map • Existing physics, boats and attraction contracts are preserved • Read pier-roadmap.md for heights and access decisions.
